directions.engawa: Create a polished production-quality mobile game UI mockup for original Chinese pet companionship game 丸宠. Single focused primary home screen. Portrait logical 390 x 844, tall aspect ratio. App content only, no device bezel, no OS status bar, no home indicator, no surrounding presentation board. Japanese quiet leisurely minimalist aesthetic, exceptionally thoughtful hierarchy and typography. Readable Chinese body type 14-16pt logical, generous intentional whitespace, clear one primary action and at most two secondary entrances. No stats, currency, urgency, badges, feature inventory, dashboard cards or generic pill grid. Original 2D illustrated artwork suitable for layered PNG and sprite animation in Godot, not 3D rendering. Reference 1 is original calico identity to preserve white orange charcoal fur and appealing round proportions; reference 2 is CURRENT BAD UI to replace, do not copy its tiny cat, huge empty floor or pill navigation. Reference 3 Travel Frog is principles only: calm spatial interface, never copy characters/assets/layout. Reference 4 Bears is principle only: distinctive art carries interaction, not its colors/layout. No dates. Render Chinese text accurately. Direction: 檐下慢时. Full-bleed airy hand-painted Japanese engawa veranda in morning light, sage garden beyond, very spare cream plaster, wooden porch and single low stool. Strong asymmetrical composition, cropped foreground leaves only at one edge. Hero calico lounging at lower center, LARGE enough to read expression (about 105 logical px wide), soft watercolor but deliberate crisp simplified shapes, never photorealistic. Header top left compact hand-lettered 丸宠 with tiny vermilion square signature, top right subtle menu icon. Main intimate heading near upper left '今天，也慢慢来' with secondary '小猫正在晒太阳'. Scene dominates middle 65 percent but avoid empty floor. Tiny sign-like '去庭院 →' integrated at garden threshold. Bottom quiet warm ivory strip with one richly drawn cloth travel bundle and text '准备行囊' as main action, secondary simple postcard icon with '收藏'. Carefully align text and interactive zones. Restrained forest ink, oat cream, apricot, small vermilion accent. Distinctive art-directed UI, feels like a place to stay rather than a menu. Single image only.
directions.letter: undefinedDirection: 一封远信. Entire mobile screen designed like an exquisitely typeset Japanese illustrated small literary journal, clear editorial structure, NOT a pile of cards. Warm near-white paper with barely visible grain, deep ink navy typography, small burnt-orange accent. Top at 32px margin small 丸宠 and a minimal menu at opposite edge. Large refined Chinese serif heading aligned left '留一点时间，\n陪它发呆。' at about 29pt, elegant breathing room. Underneath small understated '在家 · 窗边小屋'. Main illustration is a large original softly painted calico lying across an open window sill, paw dangling, sage curtains and sparse garden fragments; art has irregular organic edges merging into page, plenty of unpainted paper, cat expression clearly visible, about 130px wide. Composition balances large expressive cat in upper-middle with fine editorial typography. Below a fine rule, a small actual visual postcard preview placed at left beside '把远方，收进日常' and subtle '翻看收藏 →' secondary action. At bottom one dark desaturated navy understated rectangular button '准备行囊' with small line drawing travel bundle; button 52 logical px high with 8px corner, not pill. Tiny quiet text link '回到庭院' adjacent above button. Bottom margins generous. No fake notification or unearned travel reward, postcard is a neutral collection entrance illustration. Beautiful negative space, asymmetry, tactile original watercolor, no drop shadows. This is usable app screen not poster; keep controls clear and text readable. One image.
directions.courtyard: undefinedDirection: 小院留白. Contemporary Japanese picture-book graphic design. A charming flattened side-on cutaway of one tiny house and adjoining garden on a pale blue-green field, restrained matte gouache shapes, subtle pencil contours, simple large readable silhouettes, elegant uncluttered graphic composition. Strongly different from watercolor realism. Preserve original round calico markings but simplify to clean handpainted patches. Hero cat strolling slowly near a low window, body about110 logical px wide, expressive and relaxed. House is an offwhite architectural block asymmetrically occupying middle-left, muted terracotta roof cropped near top, one dark forest window, a potted tree at right and pale sunny walking strip. Only a few lovingly drawn objects. At top generous 32px whitespace small original 丸宠 wordmark left, small outlined menu right, below medium Chinese title '小院里，没有急事。'. Integrate two clear labeled scene objects: linen bag beside door '行囊' with understated ochre selection patch as the one primary action, small wall-mounted postcard folder '收藏' secondary. No floating tooltips or game badges. A small ground-level link '进小屋 →' near door. Bottom 100px calm pale cream area contains one short line '陪它走一会儿' and tiny explanatory '轻点空地，小猫会慢慢走过去', black-green readable text. Art is native flat 2D illustration not isometric 3D, no photorealistic materials. Short dark contours, soft organic geometry, one memorable ochre sunlight shape ties artwork to touch affordance. Achieve deliberate world-as-interface hierarchy, no standard tabbar, no generic dashboard. One image.
